resources.string: A quiet place to run Minecraft: Java Edition on Android.
Create an instance to choose a Minecraft version and a loader. The installer is not connected in this build.
This build proves the app shell, theme, navigation and process boundaries. It does not install or launch Minecraft.

The five destinations, the brand palette, the adaptive icon and the separate game and installer activities are real. Every value about a game, account or download will come from a verified source later, never from a placeholder.
Each instance will own a Minecraft version, a loader, a mod set and a worlds directory. Nothing has been created yet.
The instance editor arrives with the install pipeline. This screen does not pretend an instance exists.
Modrinth search will live here once the network and install layers exist. No project data is shown in this build.
A search field that returns nothing would be a lie. This screen will appear when the Modrinth client and the install sheet are real.
Active, queued and finished transactions will be listed here, with the reason for every stop.
Downloads are persisted transactions, not an in-memory spinner. The queue will survive a process death when the installer is wired up.
Off by default. The brand palette keeps Eclipse recognizable and preserves status contrast.
